ComponentDescription: One-shot: fetches the Matter hub device list (GET_DEVICES_LIST) once and publishes it to rdk/matter/devices/list via the AWS IoT HTTPS data endpoint using the Nucleus certs, then exits.

Run.Script:
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/bin:/opt/usr/bin:$PATH"
echo "[matter-devicelist] one-shot: hub=$HUB_API topic=$LIST_TOPIC"
rm -f /tmp/rdk_matter_devices.json
curl -s -g --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 30 "$HUB_API?GET_DEVICES_LIST" -o /tmp/rdk_matter_devices.json
if [ -s /tmp/rdk_matter_devices.json ]; then
  curl -s --tlsv1.2 --cacert "$ROOT_CA" --cert "$CERT_PATH" --key "$KEY_PATH" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @/tmp/rdk_matter_devices.json "$AWS_ENDPOINT/topics/$LIST_TOPIC?qos=1" > /dev/null
  echo "[matter-devicelist] published to $LIST_TOPIC"
else
  echo "[matter-devicelist] hub unreachable or empty response"
fi
